# Jesus’ Prayer in the Garden (Luke 22:42)

## Emotional Focus
Talking to God when our hearts feel heavy.

## Key KJV
“Not my will, but thine, be done.” (Luke 22:42)

## Gentle Retelling
In the garden Jesus prayed with tears. He told His Father exactly how He felt and then said, “Not what I want — what You want.” God gave Him strength.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus kneeling and praying under olive trees in the quiet garden at night.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“You can tell God exactly how you feel — He understands.”
